description: Agent Veterinary Records: submit surgery records with the admission, anesthesia, post-operative, discharge and treatment records they answer to: each admission entry with its id, reference, the animal and the moment admitted; each surgery entry with its id, reference, the animal, the surgical procedure, the surgeon and the moment operated; each anesthesia entry with its id, reference, the surgery, the anesthetic agent and the moment induced; each post-operative or discharge entry with its id, reference, the surgery, its kind (post_operative or discharge) and the moment recorded; each treatment entry citing a surgery with its id, reference, the surgery and the surgery date it states. The signed report gives the surgeries and the records behind them, each surgery against the anesthesia entry behind it, each surgery against a post-operative or discharge entry, each procedure against an admission entry for its animal on or before the day operated, and each surgery date against the date the treatment record states, and counts them, and names divergent surgery records: a surgery recorded with no anesthesia entry behind it, a surgery entry with no post-operative or discharge entry, a procedure recorded for an animal with no admission entry, and a surgery date the treatment record contradicts; then a post-operative or discharge entry dated before its surgery and an anesthesia, post-operative or discharge entry naming a surgery the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No surgery entries, no anesthesia entries, no post-operative or discharge entries, or no admission entries beside surgeries leaves those points unverified. Surgeries, admissions and animals match by letters and digits, so SX-0702 and SX 0702 are one surgery, dates read by the day, and an admission counts on or before the day of surgery. This reads whether every surgery on the practice’s surgery record ran under anesthesia, on an admitted animal, closed with a post-operative or discharge entry, on the day the treatment record gives. Verdict vet_surgery_record_divergent, vet_surgery_record_partial, vet_surgery_record_unverified or vet_surgery_record_consistent. POST /api/vet-surgery-record-check. Reads the veterinary practice records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it treats no animal, contacts no regulator, pharmacy or other practice and issues no license, prescription or certification, which stay with the practice, its veterinarians and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Veterinary Records reads a veterinary practice’s own records: animal records, vaccination records, treatment records with dental procedures as treatment entries, surgery records, prescription records, lab records, veterinarian license records and controlled substance log records, each against the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records, the rabies currency dates and booster schedule the record states, the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records, the admission, anesthesia and recovery entries, the refill counts and the controlled substance log, the lab orders, the signed practice records and license classes, or the log’s own totals and inventory counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the practice: what the animal record shows, what the treatment and surgery records support, what the license record covers, and whether the prescription records and controlled substance logs hold up; it reads records held by a veterinary practice or clinic, whatever the species, not farm production records and not human healthcare records: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, herd treatments the farm itself recorded included, and the Agent Healthcare family reads human healthcare records, while this family reads a veterinary practice’s own records and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-veterinary-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-veterinary-records/.

kind.description: A post-operative or a discharge entry.

ref.description: The post-operative or discharge entry reference.

surgeon.description: The veterinarian, by license reference or name.

treatments.description: Each treatment record entry that cites a surgery.

surgery_at.description: The surgery date the treatment record states, such as 2026-03-02.
